name: claudeconnect
notes: Picking a command from the / list (a click, Enter or Tab) now puts it in the message box, like in Claude, so you can write what goes with it and send them together. Enter on a command you've typed out in full still sends it straight away.
A command at the start of the message box is highlighted, and so is one in a sent message, so it's clear it's a command.
Commands that need a conversation (/clear, /compact, /rename, /recap) only show once a chat has started.
Commands that don't work from the site are no longer listed: the terminal's own (/color, /focus, /doctor), /reload-skills, /reload-plugins, /heapdump, /debug and /list-agents.

Fixed: answering one of the site's own questions (like "Use the ChatGPT template?") right after another could be missed, and a change made in Settings could look undone for a moment while the page was still loading.
